title: Letter to Church Leaders in Jackson County, Missouri, 10 August 1833
source_note: Oliver Cowdery, Letter with postscript by JS, Kirtland Mills, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to William W. Phelps, John Whitmer, Edward Partridge, Isaac Morley, John Corrill, and Sidney Gilbert, Independence, Jackson Co., MO, 10 Aug. 1833; recipient’s copy, [ca. Sept. 1833]; handwriting of Edward Partridge; two pages; CHL. Includes docket. Two leaves measuring 7⅞ × 6¼ inches (20 × 16 cm). Partridge used the second leaf as a wrapper and inscribed a docket on the wrapper: “Copy of a letter from O. Cowdery & J. Smith Jr.” The document was folded multiple times. Edward Partridge Lyman, a great-grandson of Edward Partridge, donated this document to the Church Historian’s Office in 1972.
